- Renderer Process
  - Editor Interface
  - Browser View

- Storage

a) Internal Communication
- IPC (Inter-Process Communication) between Main and Renderer processes

- File system interactions
- Project deployment flow

Use different shapes and colors to represent:

- State management

Include:
- Local development setup
- Build pipeline
- Deployment process

- The WebView integration for live preview
- The real-time editing capabilities
- The code generation and synchronization system
- The project management workflow

Use a hierarchical layout with:
- Top level: User interface and interaction layer

This will create a comprehensive visualization of Onlook's architecture while maintaining clarity and usefulness for the development team.
